name: Respecting Others
overview: Scripture calls believers to honor and love others with a Christ-centered heart, emphasizing respect through obedience to parental instruction and brotherly love. Jesus teaches the Golden Rule, urging us to treat others as we wish to be treated, extending kindness even to those who wrong us. This respect reflects God's love for the world, demonstrated supremely in the gift of His Son, and calls us to prefer one another in honor and affection.
